The '''Alsakani liberation of Virujansi''' of the [[First Alsakan Conflict]] took place in [[17,012 BBY]]. After the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]{{'}} [[Republic assault on Virujansi|assault]] on [[Virujansi/Legends|Virujansi]] [[17,018 BBY|six years earlier]], the [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakanis]] liberated the planet in this battle.
